entities.name: Artūrs Plēsnieks
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Artūrs Plēsnieks is a Latvian weightlifter. He has received several medals at junior competitions, including gold medal at Junior World Championships 2010 (385 kg). Plēsnieks has competed in several World Championships, and three Olympics, winning the bronze medal in the 109 kg division at the 2020 Olympics.
